description: This file defines interfaces and utilities for extracting function information from Torch IR graphs for ONNX export. It includes function declarations for mapping node attribute names, clearing scope records, and tracking scope attributes within the context of Torch JIT's ONNX conversion.

classes.name: NodeAttrNameMap
classes.description: Type alias for a map from IR Nodes to their attribute name mappings, used to track attribute name correspondence during ONNX export.

methods.name: ONNXFunctionExtraction
methods.description: Extracts subgraph patterns of functions and creates local function nodes for ONNX export, also returns a map of node attribute names.

methods.name: ONNXClearScopeRecords
methods.description: Clears recorded scope attribute information during ONNX export.

methods.name: ONNXTrackScopeAttributes
methods.description: Tracks and records scope-specific attributes within the computational graph for ONNX export.
